annotations.title: What was filmed at a place

description: Returns everything recorded as made at a place, most widely covered first. Takes the place as a slug (e.g. "skellig-michael") or as a name. Each result carries a `relation` field, because a video game, an anime or a manga tied to a place is set there, not filmed there.
name: what_was_filmed_here
title: What was filmed at a place
